scope.note: Natural polished at or above the threshold entering the customs territory.

checks.label: Weight agrees across documents
checks.plain: The lab report and the invoice describe the same stone.

checks.label: Invoice names the report we hold
checks.plain: The invoice points at this exact grading report.

checks.label: Shape agrees
checks.plain: Both papers describe the same cut.

checks.label: Origin matches the mining certificate
checks.plain: The country on the invoice is the country on the certificate.

checks.label: Not a sanctioned source
checks.plain: The stone did not come out of a country under sanction.

checks.label: System of Warranties wording present
checks.plain: Every invoice in the chain carries the warranty sentence.

checks.label: Weights make sense
checks.plain: You cannot get more polished out than the rough could hold.

checks.label: Filing needed
checks.plain: Natural and at or above half a carat, so the EU requires this filing.

evidence_required: Goods line: HS code, piece count, total carats, customs value
Declaration that the goods are not of Russian Federation origin
Declaration that reasonable steps were taken and that no aggregation applies
Named authorised signatory, place and date of signing

wrong_origin.measure: up to 40 percent of shipment value plus seizure of the goods

sanctioned.measure: USD 377,700 per violation or twice the transaction value, whichever is greater
